title: Shared platform service classification
responsibility: Distinguishes private descendants from vetted shared Xcode services, protecting processes whose identity or authority cannot be established.

inputs.name: classifyProcess.known
inputs.description: Tracked pid and start time identifying the process to classify.

inputs.name: classifyProcess.context
inputs.description: Developer-tool authority supplier, command group, optional probes and cancellation signal.

inputs.name: stillPrivate.known
inputs.description: Tracked process identity to recheck immediately before signalling.

inputs.name: stillPrivate.judgedAs
inputs.description: Executable path recorded when the process was judged private, or null when none was known.

inputs.name: stillPrivate.context
inputs.description: Probe context used for the final identity and executable check.

outputs.name: macAuthority
outputs.description: Selected canonical Xcode authority from synchronous xcode-select, or null when selection cannot be established.

outputs.name: platformServices
outputs.description: Promise of the selected Xcode authority using bounded asynchronous probes, or null when unavailable.

outputs.name: classifyProcess
outputs.description: Verdict with standing, reason and executable: gone for changed/absent identity, private for ordinary known programs, delegated for a fully vouched system-adopted service, otherwise protected.

outputs.name: stillPrivate
outputs.description: True only if start time and executable still match and the process is not named as a guarded shared service or launcher; performs no signal itself.
